brand_spec.notes: Brand derived from classical liberal arts educational context - restrained elegance over flashiness. Typography-forward design with serif headings conveys authority and timelessness.

visual_direction.primary_change: Typography refinement - editorial feel through refined serif headings paired with Source Sans 3 body text. Classical motion philosophy applied to all interactive components with subtle scale(1.02) hover states. Services section upgraded to elevated card treatment for visual hierarchy.
visual_direction.rationale: The BrandSpec defines a classical liberal arts brand personality requiring refined, contemplative aesthetics. Lora serif headings convey established credibility and warmth appropriate for mission-driven organizations. The 'classical' motion_philosophy (400ms ease-out with subtle spring) is applied consistently across all components. Source Sans 3 body ensures readability while maintaining the warm, accessible tone. The 0.25rem border_radius and subtle shadow_scale preserve the professional, understated refinement. BrandSpec fidelity maintained - no new colors or tokens introduced.
designer_notes: BrandSpec 'classical' motion philosophy (400ms ease-out with cubic-bezier spring) applied to all interactive elements for cohesive experience
Service cards use elevated card variant with larger shadow on hover to create visual hierarchy in the services grid
Portfolio gallery items use motion-subtle (opacity fade) to avoid competing with case study content
Contact form inputs feature subtle border-color transition matching motion_philosophy duration
All colors trace to BrandSpec tokens - primary_color #1E293B for headings, accent_color #7C3AED for interactive accents
Footer social links use ghost button styling with motion-subtle for understated presence
Dark mode will use [data-theme="dark"] with inverted BrandSpec tokens via full_tokens strategy

ui_polish_changes.change: Added motion-classical, motion-subtle, motion-monastic CSS classes for component animation variants
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.motion_class_map defines motion classes for different interaction types - ensures consistent motion philosophy across components

ui_polish_changes.change: Added card-hover and card-elevated hover utility classes with scale(1.02) transform
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.motion_delta.hover_scale is 1.02 - applies classical motion to card interactions

ui_polish_changes.change: Added prefers-reduced-motion media query to disable animations
ui_polish_changes.reason: Accessibility requirement - motion should be disabled for users who prefer reduced motion

ui_polish_changes.change: Applied card-elevated variant to service cards with larger shadow on hover
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.impacted_components includes service-cards with elevated treatment for visual hierarchy

ui_polish_changes.change: Applied motion-subtle to portfolio items for understated presence
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.designer_notes: 'Portfolio gallery items use motion-subtle (opacity fade) to avoid competing with case study content'

ui_polish_changes.change: Applied motion-subtle to form inputs for focus transitions
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.motion_class_map.form_input_focus: motion-subtle, designer_notes: 'Contact form inputs feature subtle border-color transition'

ui_polish_changes.change: Kept cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) spring easing despite impeccable detect warning
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.motion_delta.easing explicitly specifies cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) as the classical spring easing. This is intentional brand design choice, not bounce animation antipattern.

visual_weight_issues: Hero section text could be larger on desktop for more impact
Portfolio thumbnails are low-res (49x34px from source) - may appear pixelated on high-DPI displays
typography_hierarchy_suggestions: Consider adding a caption/eyebrow style above h1 in hero for visual depth
H4 headings in component use Source Sans 3 while H1-H3 use Lora - this is intentional per VisualDirection but could benefit from more differentiation
emotional_resonance_gaps: Personal bio section could include more warmth through spacing and typography variation
Contact form success state could be more celebratory to match the 'Let's Talk' conversational tone
brand_token_violations: Impeccable detect flagged cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) as bounce easing - this is a false positive; the VisualDirection explicitly specifies this spring easing as the classical motion characteristic
self_critique.recommended_action: None - acceptable trade-off. The classical spring easing is explicitly specified in VisualDirection and represents intentional brand design. Portfolio thumbnails are preserved from source CDN to maintain authenticity.
